scope_review.separation: Clearly excludes changing finally or generic dup handling; separates instance receiver prefix/postfix, static postfix old-value, and void-only/unit-update behavior. Other rules may still accept another form where their own contract applies.
scope_review.FO_attribution: FO.evalThenFin already emits a saved return value before the finally store. The whole-class compile red is attributed to bump() fallback at BCI 5/copy diagnostics, not to finally recovery.
scope_review.evidence_vs_claim: README/design distinguish original-only FO/driver controls from future rebuilt-only acceptance; two compiler legs provide real original behavior, but there is no complete generated FO compile or generated runtime success in this package. New static-prefix capability remains not implemented (0/6 tasks).
scope_review.contract_alignment: Proposal, design, delta, and tasks share the same field/value guard; tasks require actual producer/consumer/source-map, stop, compatibility, whole-source rebuild, Java8/23 and CI proof. The independent driver/oracles are unchanged controls, not product proof.
scope_review.external_tool_boundary: Archive includes captured inputs, original/generated classes and sources, argv/receipts/raw; the JDK and CLI are pinned externally, as the README states.
